description: Header file defining the 'Context' class and related functions for managing device and backend configurations in PyTorch's ATen library.

classes.name: Context
classes.description: Manages device configurations, backend preferences, and deterministic settings for PyTorch's ATen library.

methods.name: defaultGenerator
methods.description: Returns the default generator for a given device.

methods.name: getAcceleratorHooksInterface
methods.description: Retrieves the appropriate hooks interface for a specified device type.

methods.name: getDeviceFromPtr
methods.description: Determines the device associated with a data pointer.

methods.name: isPinnedPtr
methods.description: Checks if a pointer is pinned memory for a device.

methods.name: getPinnedMemoryAllocator
methods.description: Returns the pinned memory allocator for a device.

methods.name: lazyInitDevice
methods.description: Initializes device-specific resources lazily.

methods.name: hasOpenMP
methods.description: Checks if OpenMP is available.

methods.name: hasMKLDNN
methods.description: Checks if MKLDNN is available.

methods.description: Checks if MAGMA is available.

methods.name: hasCUDA
methods.description: Checks if CUDA is available.

methods.name: hasHIP
methods.description: Checks if HIP is available.

methods.name: hasXLA

methods.description: Checks if XPU is available.

methods.name: hasMPS

methods.name: hasIPU
methods.description: Checks if IPU is available.

methods.name: hasHPU
methods.description: Checks if HPU is available.

methods.name: getNumGPUs
methods.description: Returns the number of CUDA (or HIP) GPUs.

methods.name: manual_seed
methods.description: Sets the seed for random number generators.

methods.name: alertNotDeterministic
methods.description: Throws an error if deterministic algorithms are enforced but the operation is nondeterministic.

methods.name: setFloat32MatmulPrecision
methods.description: Sets the precision mode for float32 matrix multiplication.

methods.name: setFloat32Precision
methods.description: Sets the float32 precision for a specific backend and operation.

methods.name: allowTF32CuDNN
methods.description: Checks if TF32 is allowed in cuDNN.

methods.name: setAllowTF32CuDNN
methods.description: Enables or disables TF32 in cuDNN.

methods.name: float32MatmulPrecision
methods.description: Retrieves the current float32 matrix multiplication precision setting.

methods.name: float32Precision
methods.description: Gets the float32 precision for a specific backend and operation.

methods.name: allowFP16ReductionCuBLAS
methods.description: Gets the current CuBLAS FP16 reduction option.

methods.name: setAllowFP16ReductionCuBLAS
methods.description: Sets the CuBLAS FP16 reduction options.

methods.name: allowBF16ReductionCuBLAS
methods.description: Gets the current BF16 reduction option for CuBLAS.

methods.name: setAllowBF16ReductionCuBLAS
methods.description: Sets the BF16 reduction options for CuBLAS.

methods.name: allowFP16AccumulationCuBLAS
methods.description: Checks if FP16 accumulation is allowed in CuBLAS.

methods.name: setAllowFP16AccumulationCuBLAS
methods.description: Enables or disables FP16 accumulation in CuBLAS.

methods.name: _SMCarveout_EXPERIMENTAL
methods.description: Gets the experimental SM carveout setting.

methods.name: _setSMCarveout_EXPERIMENTAL
methods.description: Sets the experimental SM carveout.

methods.name: qEngine
methods.description: Gets or sets the quantization engine.

methods.name: setQEngine
methods.description: Sets the quantization engine.

methods.name: supportedQEngines
methods.description: Returns supported quantization engines.

methods.name: setCheckSparseTensorInvariants
methods.description: Enables or disables sparse tensor invariant checks.

methods.name: checkSparseTensorInvariants
methods.description: Checks if sparse tensor invariants are enabled.

methods.name: setReleaseWeightsWhenPrepacking
methods.description: Sets whether to release original weights after pre-packing.

methods.name: releaseWeightsWhenPrepacking
methods.description: Checks if release of weights after prepacking is enabled.

methods.name: setDisplayVmapFallbackWarnings
methods.description: Enables or disables Vmap fallback warnings.

methods.name: areVmapFallbackWarningsEnabled
methods.description: Checks if Vmap fallback warnings are enabled.

methods.name: setWarnOnAccumulateGradStreamMismatch
methods.description: Enables or disables warnings on accumulate grad stream mismatch.

methods.name: warnOnAccumulateGradStreamMismatch
methods.description: Checks if warnings on accumulate grad stream mismatch are enabled.

methods.name: isDefaultMobileCPUAllocatorSet
methods.description: Checks if default mobile CPU allocator is set.

methods.name: setDefaultMobileCPUAllocator
methods.description: Sets the default mobile CPU allocator.

methods.name: unsetDefaultMobileCPUAllocator
methods.description: Unsets the default mobile CPU allocator.

methods.name: allowFP16ReductionCPU
methods.description: Checks if FP16 reduction on CPU is allowed.

methods.name: setAllowFP16ReductionCPU
methods.description: Enables or disables FP16 reduction on CPU.
